curationLog: Rows curated 2026-08-30 by three research agents (docs/RESEARCH/benchmark-curation-2026-08-30.md): US and UK from official statistics (BLS OEWS public API, ONS ASHE 2025 provisional), GCC from GulfTalent public salary pages, India from Instahyre public reports, Singapore from Morgan McKinley 2026 public tables, Germany from Stepstone Gehalt pages.

Conflict rule: when two sources cover the same cell, the higher-quality row wins and the alternative is recorded in the row note. ARE it-executive executive: the enterprise recruiter-band row (Medium) was kept over the GulfTalent CTO page (n=15, Low); the GulfTalent figures are noted on the row.
Countries use ISO3 codes; UK rows are recorded as GBR.

Egypt and Indonesia have zero benchmark rows after every allowed free source failed verification (gated guides, dead tools, entry-level-only data). Their cells stay insufficient-data markers rather than shipping unverifiable numbers.

Second Asia/EU pass (duplicate agent) added 18 cells the first pass missed: Singapore non-tech sectors, Egypt tech bands (egytech.fyi 2025 community survey, 1,413 responses, EGP 2025 data with currency caveat), and German lead titles. Overlapping cells kept the first-pass rows per the conflict rule (SGP it-executive executive stays as Head of Infrastructure rather than the CISO mapping).

Expansion wave 3 (2026-09-02, docs/RESEARCH/benchmark-curation-2026-08-30.md): France 22 rows (Robert Half France 2026 guide grids verified verbatim, guide FAQ states figures are starting fixed gross annual pay; TPC Recrutement 2026 medians with stated samples; Capital.fr reproducing the LHH 2025 marketing grid), Spain 16 rows (INE Cuatrienal Estructura Salarial 2022 quartile series via wstempus JSON, quality capped at Medium for the 2022 vintage; Tecnoempleo Sept 2026 gross annual bands; InfoJobs 2024 offered averages), Poland 22 rows (Just Join IT 2026 report UoP gross medians from 2025 postings; Sedlak and Sedlak Ogolnopolskie Badanie Wynagrodzen quartiles updated January 2026 with stated samples), Turkey 7 rows all Low (SalaryExpert ERI pages, senior 8+ years average annual gross, ERI publishes averages not percentiles). All anchors independently re-fetched and matched verbatim before merge.

Expansion wave 4 (2026-09-02, docs/RESEARCH/benchmark-curation-2026-08-30.md): Italy 37 rows (Manageritalia-JobPricing dirigenti RAL via free press reproductions, Orizzonte Scuola statutory CCNL teacher tables, TechCompenso crowd data held Low), Sweden 39 rows (SCB wage structure statistics 2025 with true percentiles, Unionen market-salary spans with disclosed midpoints), Norway 25 rows (SSB statbank 11418 occupation monthly earnings median and quartiles from the a-meldingen registry, all High), Denmark 32 rows (DST LONS20 register quartiles converted with DST's own 160.33-hour factor, PROSA payslip statistics), Czechia 38 rows (ISPV national wage survey 2025 XLSX quartiles, platy.cz decile spans with disclosed midpoints), Portugal 17 rows (PORDATA republication of Quadros de Pessoal 2024 official means, Landing.jobs 2025 tech report with stated method). All anchors independently re-fetched and matched verbatim before merge; SCB's suppressed finance-executive quartile collapsed to median-only.

Expansion wave 5 (2026-09-02, docs/RESEARCH/benchmark-curation-2026-08-30.md): Finland 34 rows (Statistics Finland Structure of Earnings 2024 via PxWeb deciles and median by 4-digit occupation, decile convention disclosed per row; TEK survey; koodaripula.fi Duunitori job-ad quartiles), Austria 48 rows (Statistik Austria Allgemeiner Einkommensbericht 2024 ODS with true quartiles by OEISCO group; karriere.at job-ad levels; kununu held Low), Belgium 25 rows (Statbel SES occupation means, Onderwijs Vlaanderen official teacher scales, Jobat nurse scales), Romania 17 rows (INS sector means via salariile.ro republication, statutory medic primar scale span, Paylab decile spans held Low), Greece 39 rows (Eurostat SES 2022 occupation-by-sector means, Greek Ministry of Finance statutory public-sector examples, Paylab crowd spans held Low). All anchors independently re-fetched and matched verbatim before merge; span rows carry disclosed midpoints.

Expansion wave 6 (2026-09-03, docs/RESEARCH/benchmark-curation-2026-08-30.md): Israel 38 rows (Manpower Israel salary tables with stated gross basis, Knesset Research Center teacher data via Calcalist, Ministry of Finance physician data via Bizportal; Avodata official portal bot-blocked), Chile 28 rows (Buk Guia Salarial real-payroll bands via press reproduction, IT Workers headhunting guide, Lota municipal statutory scale; INE ESI rejected for net basis), Colombia 23 rows (Buk Colombia payroll percentile bands, Michael Page Colombia free tool, El Tiempo statutory teacher table), Argentina 31 rows (sysarmy/OpenQube 2026.01 survey medians with the peso subset identified, ATE Decreto 1133/09 statutory health scale, iProfesional press synthesis held Low). New floor-only convention: cells with a single published floor store it as a median-only row with the floor disclosed. Taiwan had 46 verified rows curated (104 Salary Guide published P25/P50/P75 by title and tenure with sample counts) but is NOT in the 206-country list because the World Bank PPP pipeline has no Taiwan data; those rows stay parked in the research file pending an owner decision on extending the country list. All anchors independently re-fetched and matched verbatim before merge.

Taiwan addition (2026-09-03): the owner approved Taiwan as the 207th supported country, so the 46 rows parked from wave 6 now merge. Rows are 104 Salary Guide published P25/P50/P75 monthly bands by title and tenure with per-band sample counts (Medium, n under 100 held Low), corroborated by the MOL 2025 occupational wage survey; every figure verified against 104's public JSON. Taiwan PPP is the IMF WEO implied conversion rate (GDP basis, 2025) since the World Bank has no Taiwan series; no statutory tax regime, so the disclosed 20 percent default applies.

Expansion wave 7 (2026-09-04, docs/RESEARCH/benchmark-curation-2026-08-30.md): the remaining EEA markets plus Peru, 13 countries, 418 rows, closing out Europe. Bulgaria 46 (Eurostat SES 2022 backbone plus State Gazette statutory teacher minima), Croatia 34 all-High (Eurostat plus Croatian public-service coefficients on the verified 2026 base), Cyprus 30 (Eurostat plus CYSTAT via attributed reproduction plus CareerFinders), Estonia 23 (Statistics Estonia register-based palgad.stat.ee medians), Iceland 39 all-High (Statistics Iceland VIN02001 quartiles with a disclosed seniority proxy), Lithuania 39 (manoalga.lt self-reported spans, all Low, official sources Cloudflare-blocked), Luxembourg 23 (Eurostat, Eurydice statutory teachers, ITM social-sector grid, Robert Half), Malta 29 (gov.mt 2026 payscales, Eurostat, Archer guide), Slovakia 40 (platy.sk spans mostly Low, Health Ministry statutory physician tables), Slovenia 37 all-High (SURS quartiles by occupation), Peru 28 (gob.pe statutory comunicado, MTPE Planilla Electronica physician averages, Buk Peru payroll bands), Hungary 25 and Latvia 25 built directly by the reviewer from the same verified Eurostat SES pull when the research agents hit an account usage limit. One Slovak rolling-survey row re-verified and updated to the page's current endpoints. All anchors independently verified; Iceland and Estonia anchors corroborated exactly against Eurostat because their national APIs block this network.

Western Balkans pass (2026-09-05): Serbia 25, Bosnia and Herzegovina 25, North Macedonia 24, and Albania 21 rows, built directly by the reviewer from Eurostat SES 2022 (earn_ses22_48, mean monthly gross, enterprises with 10 or more employees, total sex) on the exact Hungary and Latvia recipe: senior cells are ISCO major group 2 professionals in the family's NACE sector, lead cells are ISCO major group 1 managers in the same sector, and executive cells share the economy-wide managers pool. Albania publishes no economy-wide managers cell (so no executive rows) and North Macedonia misses only the finance managers cell. Montenegro and Kosovo publish nothing in this dataset and stay marker-only. Median-only rows carrying published means, with the all-seniority-mean disclosure in every note; each source URL is the exact filtered API cell. Every value is verbatim from the API response captured on merge day.

USD-quoted figures in the Lebanese market, where most professional tech pay is negotiated in fresh US dollars. Band of 3,500 to 6,000 USD per month for senior engineers at local employers (funded startups, agencies, banks, outsourcing firms) published May and July 2026 by LeBusiness, derived from active job listings and its own 2026 report; p25 and p75 are the band edges and p50 is the band midpoint. Excludes fully remote developers working for foreign employers, who earn far more (Plane payroll median 64,394 USD per year). Source is a single secondary aggregator that explicitly rejects banned crowd databases; InfoPro's 2025 Salary Scale survey separately reports IT management and technical roles about 40 percent above 2018 levels, consistent with a dollarized senior market.

Band from CCNL Area Istruzione e Ricerca 2022-2024 components, signed at ARAN on 6 August 2026 and covered by PMI.it: stipendio tabellare annuo lordo rises from 47,015.73 to 50,005.73 EUR (p25 = 50,006, guaranteed floor) and the fixed part of the position retribution rises from 13,345.11 to 14,515.11 EUR, giving p50 = 64,521 (50,005.73 + 14,515.11 = 64,520.84, arithmetic sum of on-page figures). p75 = 94,628: the same sum plus the maximum variable position retribution for fascia A schools of 30,107.56 EUR, verified pre-renewal on dirigentiscuola.org (which shows the pre-renewal maximum total of 90,468.44; applying the two renewed components gives 94,628.40). ARAN states average increases of 500 EUR gross per month over 13 payments, equal to 8.48 percent, which implies an average total compensation around 83,000 EUR, inside the band. Population: 7,550 dirigenti scolastici. Basis authority: figures stated as annual gross (annuo lordo) in both sources. Quality High: contractual figures. Same-cell alternative: university full professor (professore ordinario) at 3,300 to 4,000 EUR per month gross per PMI.it.

p50 is the midpoint of the source's published 10th to 90th percentile span; the span endpoints are stored as p25 and p75 and are wider than quartiles.
